mentions.name: Hister
mentions.description: Hister is a self-hosted search service and full text indexer for websites and local files. It automatically saves all pages visited in the browser, provides offline result previews, and offers flexible web and terminal search interfaces with a query language to explore saved content, with quick fallback to traditional search engines.
mentions.problem: Dependence on online search engines; the goal is to reduce reliance on services like Google, DuckDuckGo, and Kagi by searching a local index of visited pages and files.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on a self-hosted search service called Hister with the goal to reduce dependence on online search engines. Hister is a full text indexer for websites and local files which automatically saves all the visited pages rendered by your browser. It provides offline result previews, a flexible web (and terminal) search interface & query language to explore saved content with ease or quickly fall back to traditional search engines.

mentions.name: Hister
mentions.description: A free general purpose web search engine that provides automatic full-text indexing for visited websites. Planned work includes adding new extractors and optimizing indexer storage by moving HTML/favicon content out of the index and storing it in an efficient compressed form.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'll continue to work on https://github.com/asciimoo/hister as much as I can. I plan to add new extractors and optimize the indexer storage usage by moving out HTML/favicon content from the index and storing them in an efficient compressed way.

Hister is a free general purpose web search engine providing automatic full-text indexing for visited websites.
